name: YOURS GAME
source:
The real world sucks, don't you think? Come, let me help you achieve a momentary fantasy...

You will wake up in a somewhat different world, but that does not mean that you will be free of the mundane problems that life has with it. Put everything in order, fix your pending tasks, try to optimize your time and stop being such an idiot about past problems. But where's the fun if it shows you the right path? So for now, I'll let you figure it out without my help. You can only get one ending. Try your luck! Have fun, darling~

[From [url=https://perrieridgewell.itch.io/yoursgame]Itch.io[/url]]
